integrity: Proof is supplied in RESULT.md and the exact finite checks are reproduced by the embedded standard-library program; the computation is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Indexed Palm renewal cell peaks only; atomless positive i.i.d. gaps. Gaussian asymptotic is not a fixed-spatial-window limit. Gaussian MA(1) peak counts may have prior coverage, and older peak literature could contain an equivalent general identity.
title: Distribution-free peak laws for consecutive renewal Voronoi cells
